evidence.quoted_text: const known = observation?.usage !== undefined && usage !== undefined;
evidence.reason: The current code still derives `known` at `src/ops/review/addressMany.ts:664` solely from the settled aggregate `report.usage` after normalization. It does not consult the report's `usageSummary` or per-dispatch provenance. An aggregate containing only measured dispatches can therefore be numeric and treated as fully known even when another dispatch was unmeasured, allowing settlement/refund and later admission without recording that spend. The surrounding unknown-usage path only handles an absent or malformed aggregate, so the alleged gap remains.
